target.title: fix(browser): time out response body reads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Browser response body capture could hang past its timeout when Playwright matched the response headers but the response body read never completed.

## Why This Change Was Made

The response-body path now carries the existing response deadline through the Playwright `response.body()` read instead of clearing the timer after the matching response event. This keeps the existing URL matching and body truncation behavior while preventing a stalled body read from holding the tool call indefinitely.

## User Impact

Users and automation that wait for a Browser response body now get a bounded timeout failure instead of a stuck command when the response body never resolves.

## Evidence

Current head: `a61c58749b29d211c1c0c67a87ad3e2cf2185cd3`.

- GitHub Actions `Real behavior proof` passed for this head: `node scripts/github/real-behavior-proof-check.mjs` reported `External PR includes problem context and evidence.` Job: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29613181088/job/87992337426
- GitHub Actions CI passed for this head, including `openclaw/ci-gate`, `check-lint`, `check-test-types`, `check-prod-types`, `check-dependencies`, and `build-artifacts`. CI gate job: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29612782690/job/87992133440
- The current PR diff is limited to Browser response body handling and focused regression coverage in `extensions/browser/src/browser/pw-tools-core.responses.ts` and `extensions/browser/src/browser/pw-tools-core.responses.test.ts`.
